comments: Newar master active in Nepal at the end of the eleventh century. Specified to be a female in some sources. The Newar expression "haṅdu" (Tib. sngags pa) denotes a married vajrayāna practitioner. See [LNWGLM8T]: 163-164 and [HSWMUUWK], Appendix D: 478-479.
alternative_names:
ha mu dkar po

hang bu dkar mo

bsod nams 'byung gnas
puṇyākarabhadra
name: varendraruci
